executive_summary.conclusion: Static IKEA India evidence clearly identifies the retail offer, product categories, bookcase examples, prices, current offers and support services. The main limitation is tool availability: the in-app browser disappeared after the prior case, so rendered journeys, choice retention and interactive state were not observed; no checkout, account, postcode or personal-data flow was attempted.

not_checked: Rendered browser unavailable after Standard Ebooks case; no fresh IAB tab could be created.
Keyboard focus, mobile layout, contrast, overlays, sorting/filtering state and context retention not checked.
No product detail or delivery-eligibility flow was submitted; no postcode/address, cart, checkout, login or personal details used.
No assistant answer/citation runs, provider ranking, real crawler IP access, Search Console or behavioral analytics measured.

readiness.detail: IKEA robots.txt was retrieved. Wildcard rules allow general crawling but disallow search/query, comparison, cart, checkout, profile and other dynamic/private paths; named search and training agents were not blocked by the evaluated rules.
Twelve static HTML pages exposed the India retail offer, category taxonomy, bookcase products/prices, offers, services, newsroom and room inspiration. Rendered extraction unavailable.

Four site-specific questions were tested against static first-party pages; offer, bookcase examples/prices, services and current offer caveats were answerable in the sample. Delivery eligibility by location remained not checked.

Exact-entity and neutral web retrieval returned IKEA India first-party pages first, with Ingka Group and Wikipedia as separate identity context; no material contradiction was observed in the bounded sample.
Static links establish likely product and service routes, but browser interaction was unavailable, so safe rendered journeys and non-default choices could not be exercised.

proactive_opportunities.title: Verify location-specific delivery guidance in a safe public flow
proactive_opportunities.rationale: Delivery is a material decision for Indian shoppers, while the static services page describes delivery without exposing a location-specific result in the inspected sample. A browser check can confirm whether public guidance is sufficient before checkout.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Expose or link a clear pre-purchase delivery-eligibility explanation and safe public route, without requiring account or checkout, while retaining product context.
proactive_opportunities.verification: In a fresh supported browser, start from a product/category page, use only a public delivery-information control with no personal data, and confirm visible eligibility guidance or a documented reason it is deferred.
